units.zh: ○邢簡妻陳氏耶律氏常哥耶律奴妻蕭氏耶律朮者妻蕭氏耶律中妻蕭氏
units.en: ○ Lady Chen, wife of Xing Jian; the Yelü clanswoman Changge; Lady Xiao, wife of Yelü Nu; Lady Xiao, wife of Yelü Shuzhe; Lady Xiao, wife of Yelü Zhong
units.literal: ○ The wife of Xing Jian, Lady Chen; the Yelü clanswoman Changge; the wife of Yelü Nu, Lady Xiao; the wife of Yelü Shuzhe, Lady Xiao; the wife of Yelü Zhong, Lady Xiao

units.zh: 男女居室，人之大倫。
units.en: The pairing of men and women in marriage is among the greatest norms of human life.
units.literal: Men and women dwelling together is the great norm of humanity.

units.zh: 與其得烈女，不若得賢女。
units.en: Better to gain a worthy woman than a woman celebrated chiefly for desperate virtue.
units.literal: Rather than obtaining a fierce/chaste woman, it is better to obtain a worthy woman.

units.zh: 天下而有烈女之名，非幸也。
units.en: When the realm must acclaim women chiefly for acts of desperate virtue, that is no blessing.
units.literal: For all under Heaven to have the name of fierce/chaste women is not fortunate.

units.zh: 《詩》贊衛共姜，《春秋》褒宋伯姬，蓋不得已，所以重人倫之變也。
units.en: The Book of Songs praises Wei Gong Jiang, and the Spring and Autumn Annals commends Song Bo Ji—each case arose only when there was no other choice, and thus marks how heavily human relations weigh when they are torn apart.
units.literal: The Odes praise Wei Gong Jiang; the Spring and Autumn Annals commends Song Bo Ji — this is only when there is no alternative, thereby to emphasize changes in human norms.

units.zh: 遼據北方，風化視中土為疏。
units.en: With the Liao entrenched in the north, their norms of teaching and custom were held looser than those of the central plains.
units.literal: The Liao held the north; customs and transformation were regarded as looser than the central lands.

units.zh: 終遼之世，得賢女二，烈女三，以見人心之天理有不與世道存亡者。
units.en: Across the entire Liao dynasty, only two worthy women and three women of desperate virtue were found—enough to show that the moral principle in human hearts can outlast the fortunes of the age.
units.literal: Throughout the Liao dynasty, there were obtained two worthy women and three fierce/chaste women, thereby to show that the heavenly principle in human hearts has something that does not rise and fall with worldly fortunes.

units.zh: 邢簡妻陳氏，營州人。
units.en: Lady Chen, wife of Xing Jian, came from Yingzhou.
units.literal: The wife of Xing Jian, Lady Chen, was a native of Yingzhou.

units.zh: 父陘，五代時累官司徒。
units.en: Her father Chen Xing rose repeatedly to the post of Minister over the Masses (situ) under the Five Dynasties.
units.literal: Her father Chen Xing repeatedly held the office of situ (Minister over the Masses) during the Five Dynasties period.

units.zh: 陳氏甫笄，涉通經義，凡覽詩賦，輒能誦，尤好吟詠，時以女秀才名之。
units.en: As soon as Lady Chen came of age, she had mastered the classics; whatever poetry or fu she read, she could recite from memory; she loved composing verse above all, and people called her the "female scholar."
units.literal: When Lady Chen had just reached the age of pinning up her hair, she had thoroughly grasped the meaning of the classics; whenever she looked upon poetry and fu, she could at once recite them; she especially loved composing verse, and at the time she was styled the "female xiucai."

units.zh: 年二十，歸於簡。
units.en: At twenty she married Xing Jian.
units.literal: At the age of twenty she was married to Jian.

units.zh: 孝舅姑，閨門和睦，親黨推重。
units.en: She was devoted to her parents-in-law, kept the household harmonious, and won the respect of kin and neighbors.
units.literal: She was filial toward her parents-in-law; the inner quarters were harmonious; relatives and associates held her in esteem.

units.zh: 有六子，陳氏親教以經。
units.en: She bore six sons and taught them the classics herself.
units.literal: She had six sons; Lady Chen personally instructed them in the classics.

units.zh: 後二子抱樸、抱質皆以賢，位宰相。
units.en: Two of her sons, Baopu and Baozhi, later proved themselves worthy men and rose to the chancellorship.
units.literal: Later two of her sons, Baopu and Baozhi, both proved worthy and reached the rank of chief minister.

units.zh: 統和十二年卒。
units.en: She died in the twelfth year of Tonghe (994).
units.literal: She died in the twelfth year of the Tonghe reign period.

units.zh: 睿智皇后聞之，嗟悼，贈魯國夫人，刻石以表其行。
units.en: When Empress Dowager Ruizhi heard of her death, she sighed in grief, granted her the title Lady of Lu, and had a stone inscription carved to commemorate her conduct.
units.literal: When the Empress Dowager Ruizhi heard of it, she sighed and mourned, bestowed upon her the title Lady of Lu, and had stone carved to commemorate her conduct.

units.zh: 及遷祔，遣使以祭。
units.en: When her remains were moved to joint burial with her husband, the court sent an envoy to perform the rites.
units.literal: When her remains were moved to joint entombment, the court sent an envoy to offer sacrifice.

units.zh: 論者謂貞靜柔順，婦道母儀始終無慊雲。
units.en: Commentators said she was chaste, quiet, gentle, and compliant—a model of wifehood and motherhood from first to last, without a single lapse.
units.literal: Commentators said she was chaste, quiet, gentle, and compliant—wifehood and motherhood in model form, from beginning to end without fault.

units.zh: 耶律氏，太師適魯之妹，小字常哥。
units.en: A woman of the Yelü clan, sister of Grand Preceptor Shilu, was known by the childhood name Changge.
units.literal: A woman of the Yelü clan, younger sister of Grand Preceptor Shilu, childhood name Changge.

units.zh: 幼爽秀，有成人風。
units.en: As a child she was bright and graceful, with the poise of a grown woman.
units.literal: In youth she was clever and elegant, with the bearing of an adult.

units.zh: 及長，操行修潔，自誓不嫁。
units.en: When she came of age, her conduct was refined and pure, and she vowed never to marry.
units.literal: When she had grown, her conduct was cultivated and pure; she vowed never to marry.

units.zh: 能詩文，不茍作。
units.en: She could write poetry and prose, but would not compose lightly or without purpose.
units.literal: She could compose poetry and prose and would not write carelessly.

units.zh: 讀《通曆》，見前人得失，歷能品藻。
units.en: Reading the Comprehensive Chronicles, she could appraise and classify the successes and failures of past rulers whenever she encountered them.
units.literal: Reading the Comprehensive Chronicles, whenever she saw the gains and losses of men of old, she could always appraise and classify them.

units.zh: 咸雍間，作文以述時政。
units.en: During the Xianyong reign she wrote an essay setting forth her views on current affairs.
units.literal: During the Xianyong era she wrote an essay to set forth current government.

units.zh: 其略曰：「君以民為體，民以君為心。
units.en: Its gist ran: "The ruler takes the people as his body; the people take the ruler as their heart.
units.literal: Its gist said: "The ruler takes the people as his body; the people take the ruler as their heart.

units.zh: 人主當任忠賢，人臣當去比周，則政化平，陰陽順。
units.en: The sovereign should employ the loyal and worthy; ministers should cast off cliques and factions—then government will be even and yin and yang will be in harmony.
units.literal: The sovereign ought to employ the loyal and worthy; ministers ought to remove factional cliques—then government will be made level and yin and yang will be in harmony.

units.zh: 欲懷遠則崇恩尚德，欲強國則輕徭薄賦。
units.en: To win over distant peoples, honor benevolence and virtue; to strengthen the state, lighten corvée labor and reduce taxes.
units.literal: If one wishes to cherish those afar, then esteem benevolence and honor virtue; if one wishes to strengthen the state, then lighten corvée labor and reduce taxes.

units.zh: 四端五典為治教之本，六府三事實生民之命。
units.en: The Four Beginnings and Five Canons are the foundation of rule and instruction; the Six Storehouses and Three Affairs are the lifeblood of the people.
units.literal: The Four Beginnings and Five Canons are the root of governance and instruction; the Six Storehouses and Three Affairs are the fate of the living people.

units.zh: 淫侈可以為戒，勤儉可以為師。
units.en: Let extravagance be your warning and thrift your teacher.
units.literal: Extravagance may serve as a warning; thrift may serve as a teacher.

units.zh: 錯枉則人不敢詐，顯忠則人不敢欺。
units.en: Set crooked things straight and none will dare to cheat; make loyalty plain and none will dare to deceive.
units.literal: Rectifying the crooked, then people will not dare to cheat; displaying loyalty, then people will not dare to deceive.

units.zh: 勿泥空門，崇飾土木；
units.en: Do not cling to the empty gates of Buddhism, lavishing adornment on earth and timber;
units.literal: Do not cling to the empty gates, adorning and decking out earth and timber;

units.zh: 勿事邊鄙，妄費金帛。
units.en: do not treat the borderlands lightly, squandering gold and silk in vain.
units.literal: Do not treat the border regions lightly, recklessly wasting gold and silk.

units.zh: 滿當思溢，安必慮危。
units.en: When the cup is full, think of spillage; when you are secure, reckon with danger.
units.literal: When full, think of overflowing; when secure, consider danger.

units.zh: 刑罰當罪，則民勸善。
units.en: When punishments fit the crime, the people are moved toward goodness.
units.literal: When punishments match crimes, then the people will be encouraged to do good.

units.zh: 不寶遠物，則賢者至。
units.en: If you do not treasure exotic goods from afar, the worthy will come to you.
units.literal: If one does not treasure distant goods, then the worthy will come.

units.zh: 建萬世磐石之業，制諸部強橫之心。
units.en: Build an enterprise firm as bedrock for ten thousand generations, and curb the overbearing hearts of the tribes.
units.literal: Establish the enterprise of the eternal bedrock cliff, restrain the hearts of the various tribes that are overbearing.

units.zh: 欲率下則先正身，欲治遠則始朝廷。」
units.en: To lead those below, first set your own person right; to govern what is distant, begin at court."
units.literal: If one wishes to lead those below, one must first rectify oneself; if one wishes to govern what is far, one must begin at court."

units.zh: 上稱善。
units.en: The emperor praised her essay as excellent.
units.literal: The sovereign praised it as good.

units.zh: 時樞密使耶律乙辛愛其才，屢求詩，常哥遺以回文。
units.en: At the time Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Yixin admired her talent and repeatedly asked her for poems; Changge sent him a palindrome verse in reply.
units.literal: At the time the Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Yixin admired her talent and repeatedly asked for poems; Changge sent him a palindrome verse.

units.zh: 乙辛知其諷己，銜之。
units.en: Yixin knew she was satirizing him and harbored a grudge.
units.literal: Yixin knew that it satirized him and bore resentment.

units.zh: 大康三年，皇太子坐事，乙辛誣以罪，按無跡，獲免。
units.en: In the third year of Dakang (1077), when the heir apparent was implicated in a case, Yixin falsely charged him with a crime; the investigation found no evidence, and the prince was spared.
units.literal: In the third year of Dakang, when the heir apparent was implicated in an affair, Yixin falsely charged him with a crime; though investigated with no trace found, he escaped punishment.

units.zh: 會兄適魯謫鎮州，常哥與俱，常布衣疏食。
units.en: When her elder brother Shilu was banished to Zhen Prefecture, Changge went with him and lived always in plain clothes on simple fare.
units.literal: When her elder brother Shilu was demoted to Zhen Prefecture, Changge went with him, always wearing plain clothes and eating simple food.

units.zh: 人問曰：「何自苦如此？」
units.en: Someone asked her, "Why do you torment yourself like this?"
units.literal: Someone asked, "Why torment yourself in this way?"

units.zh: 對曰：「皇儲無罪遭廢，我輩豈可美食安寢。」
units.en: She answered, "The heir apparent was innocent yet deposed—how can people like us eat fine food and sleep in peace?"
units.literal: She replied: "The heir apparent was innocent yet deposed—how can we of his party eat fine food and sleep in peace?"

units.zh: 及太子被害，不勝哀痛。
units.en: When the heir apparent was killed, her grief was beyond bearing.
units.literal: When the heir apparent was killed, she was overcome with unbearable grief.

units.zh: 年七十，卒於家。
units.en: At seventy she died at home.
units.literal: At the age of seventy she died at home.

units.zh: 耶律奴妻蕭氏，小字意辛，國舅駙馬都尉陶蘇斡之女。
units.en: Lady Xiao, wife of Yelü Nu, known by the childhood name Yixin, was the daughter of the State Uncle and Commandant-escort (imperial son-in-law) Taosuwo.
units.literal: The wife of Yelü Nu, Lady Xiao, childhood name Yixin, daughter of the State Uncle and Commandant-escort Taosuwo.

units.zh: 母胡獨公主。
units.en: Her mother was Princess Hudu.
units.literal: Her mother was Princess Hudu.

units.zh: 意幸美姿容，年二十始適奴。
units.en: Yixin was graced with fine features; at twenty she was first married to Nu.
units.literal: Yixin possessed a fine countenance; at twenty she was first married to Nu.

units.zh: 事親睦族，以孝謹聞。
units.en: She treated her kin with care and kept the clan harmonious, and was known for filial devotion.
units.literal: She served kin with harmony toward the clan and was known for filial reverence.

units.zh: 嘗與娣姒會，爭言厭魅以取夫寵，意辛曰：「厭魅不若禮法。」
units.en: Once, at a gathering of sisters-in-law, they argued over whether witchcraft was the better way to win a husband's favor; Yixin said, "Witchcraft is not as good as ritual propriety."
units.literal: Once at a gathering of sisters-in-law they disputed whether witchcraft was better to win a husband's favor; Yixin said, "Witchcraft is not as good as ritual and law."

units.zh: 眾問其故，意辛曰：「修己以潔，奉長以敬，事夫以柔，撫下以寬，毋使君子見其輕易，此之為禮法，自然取重於夫。
units.en: When they asked why, Yixin said, "Cultivate yourself in purity, serve your elders with respect, attend your husband with gentleness, and treat those below with generosity; do not let any worthy man see you behave lightly. That is ritual propriety, and by it you will naturally win your husband's regard.
units.literal: The assembly asked the reason; Yixin said, "Cultivate oneself to purity, serve elders with respect, attend the husband with gentleness, nurture those below with generosity—do not let gentlemen see one's lightness; this is ritual and law, and naturally one will be honored by the husband.

units.zh: 以厭魅獲寵，獨不愧於心乎！」
units.en: To win favor through witchcraft—would you not be ashamed before your own heart!"
units.literal: To gain favor through witchcraft—would one not alone be ashamed before one's heart!"

units.zh: 聞者大慚。
units.en: Those who heard were deeply ashamed.
units.literal: Those who heard were greatly ashamed.

units.zh: 初，奴與樞密使乙辛有隙。
units.en: Earlier, Nu and Commissioner of Military Affairs Yixin had been at odds.
units.literal: At first Nu and the Commissioner of Military Affairs Yixin had a rift.

units.zh: 及皇太子廢，被誣奪爵，沒入興聖宮，流烏古部。
units.en: When the heir apparent was deposed, Nu was falsely accused, stripped of his rank, confined in the Xingsheng Palace, and exiled to the Wugu tribe.
units.literal: When the heir apparent was deposed, he was falsely accused, his nobility stripped, and he was confiscated into the Xingsheng Palace and exiled to the Wugu tribe.

units.zh: 上以意辛公主之女，欲使絕婚。
units.en: Because Yixin was a princess's daughter, the emperor wished to dissolve the marriage.
units.literal: Because the emperor considered Yixin a daughter of the princess, he wished to make her end the marriage.

units.zh: 意辛辭曰：「陛下以妾葭莩之親，使免流竄，實天地之恩。
units.en: Yixin declined, saying, "Your Majesty, because I am kin by marriage, has spared me banishment—that is grace vast as Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: Yixin declined, saying, "Your Majesty, owing to my humble kinship by marriage, has spared me exile—that is truly the grace of Heaven and Earth.

units.zh: 然夫歸之義，生死以之。
units.en: Yet the righteousness of a wife who follows her husband is to live and die with him.
units.literal: Yet the righteousness of a wife following her husband is to live or die with him.

units.zh: 妾自笄年從奴，一旦臨難，頓爾乖離，背綱常之道，於禽獸何異？
units.en: From the day I pinned up my hair I have followed Nu; now, at the first stroke of hardship, to be torn from him at once and turn my back on the constant way—how would that differ from the beasts?
units.literal: From the year I pinned up my hair I followed Nu; suddenly meeting hardship and at once being torn apart—to turn my back on the constant way of the norms would make me no different from beasts!

units.zh: 幸陛下哀憐，與奴俱行，妾即死無恨！」
units.en: If Your Majesty will pity me and let me go with Nu, I shall die without regret!"
units.literal: May Your Majesty pity me and let me go with Nu together—then even if I die I shall have no regret!"

units.zh: 帝感其言，從之。
units.en: The emperor, moved by her words, granted her request.
units.literal: The emperor, moved by her words, assented.

units.zh: 意辛久在貶所，親執役事，雖勞無難色。
units.en: Yixin long remained in exile, personally performing menial labor; though the work was hard, her face showed no distress.
units.literal: Yixin long remained at the place of banishment, personally performing menial tasks; though toilsome, her face showed no difficulty.

units.zh: 事夫禮敬，有加於舊。
units.en: In serving her husband with ritual respect, she was even more devoted than before.
units.literal: In serving her husband with ritual respect, she was even more so than before.

units.zh: 壽隆中，上書乞子孫為著帳郎君。
units.en: During Shoulong she submitted a memorial asking that her sons and grandsons be enrolled as registered gentlemen of the imperial clan.
units.literal: During Shoulong, she submitted a memorial asking that her sons and grandsons be made zhuanglang gentlemen.

units.zh: 帝嘉其節，召舉家還。
units.en: The emperor praised her integrity and summoned her entire household home.
units.literal: The emperor praised her integrity and summoned her whole family to return.

units.zh: 子國隱，乾統間始仕。
units.en: Her son Guoyin first entered office during Qiantong.
units.literal: Her son Guoyin began to hold office in the Qiantong period.

units.zh: 保大中，意辛在臨潢，謂諸子曰：「吾度盧彥倫必叛，汝輩速避，我當死之。」
units.en: During Baoda, while Yixin was at Linhuang, she told her sons, "I am sure Lu Yanlun will rebel—you must flee at once; I shall die for it."
units.literal: In Baoda, Yixin was at Linhuang and told her sons, "I judge that Lu Yanlun will certainly rebel—you all flee quickly; I shall die for this."

units.zh: 賊至，遇害。
units.en: When the rebels came, she was killed.
units.literal: When the bandits arrived, she met with disaster and was killed.

units.zh: 耶律術者妻蕭氏，小字訛裏本，國舅孛堇之女。
units.en: Lady Xiao, wife of Yelü Shuzhe, known by the childhood name Eoliben, was the daughter of the State Uncle and Tribal Chief.
units.literal: The wife of Yelü Shuzhe, Lady Xiao, childhood name Eoliben, daughter of the State Uncle and Tribal Chief.

units.zh: 性端愨，有容色，自幼與他女異。
units.en: Upright and sincere by nature, with a comely bearing, she had been unlike other girls since childhood.
units.literal: Her nature was upright and sincere, with comely countenance; from childhood she differed from other girls.

units.zh: 年十八歸術者。
units.en: At eighteen she married Shuzhe.
units.literal: At eighteen she was married to Shuzhe.

units.zh: 謹裕貞婉，娣姒推尊之。
units.en: Careful, generous, chaste, and graceful, she was esteemed by her sisters-in-law.
units.literal: Careful, generous, chaste and graceful; sisters-in-law exalted her.

units.zh: 及居術者喪，極哀毀。
units.en: During mourning for Shuzhe, her grief and self-mortification were extreme.
units.literal: When she was in mourning for Shuzhe, her grief and self-destruction were extreme.

units.zh: 既葬，謂所親曰：「夫婦之道，如陰陽表裏。
units.en: After the burial she said to those close to her, "The way of husband and wife is like yin and yang, outer and inner.
units.literal: After the burial she said to those close to her: "The way of husband and wife is like yin and yang, outer and inner.

units.zh: 無陽則陰不能立，無表則裏無所附。
units.en: Without yang, yin cannot stand; without the outer, the inner has nothing to which it may attach.
units.literal: Without yang yin cannot stand; without outer there is nowhere for inner to attach.

units.zh: 妾今不幸失所天，且生必有死，理之自然。
units.en: I have now unhappily lost my Heaven-appointed husband; yet where there is life there must be death—that is the nature of principle.
units.literal: I now unhappily have lost Heaven's ordination for me; yet life necessarily has death—this is principle's nature.

units.zh: 術者早歲登朝，有才不壽。
units.en: Shuzhe entered court while still young; he had talent but not long life.
units.literal: Shuzhe early entered court; he had talent but not longevity.

units.zh: 天禍妾身，罹此酷罰，復何依恃。
units.en: Heaven has afflicted me with this cruel blow—what is left for me to rely upon?
units.literal: Heaven's calamity falls on me, encountering this cruel punishment—what further can I rely upon?

units.zh: 儻死者可見，則從；
units.en: If the dead can be seen, I shall follow;
units.literal: If the dead can be seen, then I shall follow;

units.zh: 不可見，則當與俱。」
units.en: if they cannot be seen, I shall die with him."
units.literal: if they cannot be seen, then I shall die together with him."

units.zh: 侍婢慰勉，竟無回意，自刃而卒。
units.en: Her serving maids urged and comforted her, but she would not change her mind and killed herself with a blade.
units.literal: Serving maids urged and encouraged her, but in the end she had no change of mind and killed herself with a blade.

units.zh: 耶律中妻蕭氏，小字挼蘭，韓國王惠之四世孫。
units.en: Lady Xiao, wife of Yelü Zhong, known by the childhood name Ruolan, was a fourth-generation descendant of King Hui of Han.
units.literal: The wife of Yelü Zhong, Lady Xiao, childhood name Ruolan, fourth-generation descendant of King Hui of Han.

units.zh: 聰慧謹願。
units.en: Intelligent, clever, careful, and dutiful.
units.literal: Intelligent, clever, careful and obedient.

units.zh: 年二十歸於中，事夫敬順，親戚咸譽其德。
units.en: At twenty she married Zhong; she served her husband with respect and compliance, and kinfolk all praised her virtue.
units.literal: At twenty she married Zhong; in serving her husband she was respectful and compliant; kinfolk all praised her virtue.

units.zh: 中嘗謂曰：「汝可粗知書，以前貞淑為鑒。」
units.en: Zhong once told her, "You should gain some rough knowledge of books, and take the chaste and worthy women of old as your mirror."
units.literal: Zhong once said to her, "You should have some rough knowledge of books; take former women of chaste integrity as your mirror."

units.zh: 遂發心誦習，多涉古今。
units.en: Thereupon she devoted herself to study and recitation, and ranged widely through ancient and modern writings.
units.literal: Thereupon she set her mind to recite and study, and ranged widely through ancient and modern works.

units.zh: 天慶中，為賊所執，潛置刃於履，誓曰：「人欲汙我者，即死之。」
units.en: During Tianqing she was seized by bandits; she secretly hid a blade in her shoe and swore, "Whoever would defile me shall die by it at once."
units.literal: In the Tianqing period she was seized by bandits; she secretly placed a blade in her shoe and swore, "Whoever wishes to defile me shall die by this at once."

units.zh: 至夜，賊遁而免。
units.en: By night the bandits fled, and she escaped.
units.literal: By night the bandits fled and she escaped.

units.zh: 久之，帝召中為五院都監，中謂妻曰：「吾本無宦情，今不能免。
units.en: After a long interval the emperor summoned Zhong to be Chief Superintendent of the Five Tribes; Zhong said to his wife, "I never wished for office, yet now I cannot escape it.
units.literal: After a long time the emperor summoned Zhong to be Chief Superintendent of the Five Tribes; Zhong said to his wife, "I originally had no wish for office, yet now cannot escape it.

units.zh: 我當以死報國，汝能從我乎？」
units.en: I shall repay the state with my life—will you follow me?"
units.literal: I shall repay the state with my death—can you follow me?"

units.zh: 挼蘭對曰：「謹奉教。」
units.en: Ruolan answered, "I respectfully accept your instruction."
units.literal: Ruolan replied, "I respectfully accept your instruction."

units.zh: 及金兵徇地嶺西，盡徙其民，中守節死。
units.en: When Jin troops overran the territory west of the mountains and relocated all the people, Zhong held to his integrity and died.
units.literal: When Jin troops overran the land west of the mountains, they moved all the people; Zhong guarded his integrity and died.

units.zh: 挼蘭悲戚不形於外，人怪之。
units.en: Ruolan showed no outward sign of grief, and people found it strange.
units.literal: Ruolan's grief and sorrow did not show outwardly; people found it strange.

units.zh: 俄躍馬突出，至中死所自殺。
units.en: Suddenly she spurred her horse and dashed out, rode to where Zhong had died, and killed herself.
units.literal: Suddenly she spurred her horse and burst forth, reaching the place where Zhong had died, and killed herself.

units.zh: 論曰：陳氏以經教二子，並為賢相，耶律氏自潔不嫁，居閨閫之內而不忘忠其君，非賢而能之乎！
units.en: The commentators say: Lady Chen taught her two sons through the classics, and both became worthy chancellors; the Yelü clanswoman kept herself pure and would not marry, yet within the inner quarters she did not forget loyalty to her sovereign—could anyone but a worthy woman do such things?
units.literal: Commentators say: Lady Chen through the classics taught her two sons, and both became worthy chancellors; the Yelü clanswoman kept herself pure and did not marry, remaining within the inner quarters yet not forgetting loyalty to her lord—could one do this if not worthy?

units.zh: 三蕭氏之節，雖烈丈夫有不能者矣
units.en: As for the integrity of the three Lady Xiao—even fierce-hearted great men there are who could not have matched it.
units.literal: The integrity of the three Lady Xiao—though fierce great men there are who could not accomplish it.

units.zh: 庚戌，皇孫延禧生。
units.en: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.
units.literal: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.

units.zh: 丁巳，以翰林學士邢抱樸為尚書、禮部侍郎、知制誥，左拾遺知制誥劉景、吏部郎中知制誥牛藏用並政事舍人。
units.en: On dingsi day Hanlin academician Xing Baopu was appointed Minister of Rites, vice minister, and drafter of edicts; left reminder and drafter of edicts Liu Jing and Ministry of Personnel bureau director and drafter of edicts Niu Cangyong were both made administrative secretaries.
units.literal: On dingsi day, Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu was made Minister of Rites, Vice Minister, and drafter of edicts; Left Reminder and drafter of edicts Liu Jing and Ministry of Personnel Bureau Director and drafter of edicts Niu Cangyong were both made Administrative Secretaries.

units.zh: 閏九月癸酉，命邢抱樸勾檢顯陵。
units.en: On guiyou day in the intercalary ninth month Xing Baopu was ordered to audit Xian Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, on guiyou day, Xing Baopu was ordered to audit Xian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 己丑，以南院樞密使蕭阿速為北府宰相，樞密副使耶律乙辛南院樞密使，惕隱查葛遼興軍節度使，魯王謝家奴武定軍節度使，東京留守吳王貼不西京留守。
units.en: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.
units.literal: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.

units.zh: 以耶律乙辛知北院樞密使事。
units.en: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

units.zh: 皇子洪基生。
units.en: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
units.literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

units.zh: 庚辰，宜、錦、乾、顯、成、川、豪、懿等州相繼皆降，上京盧彥倫叛，殺契丹人。
units.en: On gengchen day Yi, Jin, Qian, Xian, Cheng, Chuan, Hao, Yi, and other prefectures in succession all surrendered; Supreme Capital Lu Yanlun rebelled and killed Khitan people.
units.literal: On gengchen day Yi, Jin, Qian, Xian, Cheng, Chuan, Hao, Yi, and other prefectures in succession all surrendered; Supreme Capital Lu Yanlun rebelled and killed Khitan people.

units.zh: 甲子，初，張覺為遼興軍節度副使，<六>民推覺領州事。
units.en: On the jiazi day, Zhang Jue, formerly deputy military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, was acclaimed by the people to take charge of the prefecture.
units.literal: On the jiazi day, Zhang Jue, formerly deputy military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, was acclaimed by the people to take charge of the prefecture.

units.zh: 邢抱樸，應州人，刑部郎中簡之子也。
units.en: Xing Baopu, a native of Ying Prefecture, was the son of Xing Jian, director of the Ministry of Punishments.
units.literal: Xing Baopu was a man of Ying Prefecture and the son of Xing Jian, director of the Ministry of Punishments.

units.zh: 初，抱樸與弟抱質受經於母陳氏，皆以儒術顯，抱質亦官至侍中，時人榮之。
units.en: Earlier, Baopu and his younger brother Baozhi had studied the classics under their mother, Lady Chen; both rose to prominence through Confucian learning, and Baozhi also reached the post of palace attendant; men of the time took pride in the family.
units.literal: Earlier, Baopu and his younger brother Baozhi had received the classics from their mother, Lady Chen; both rose to eminence through Confucian learning; Baozhi also reached the post of palace attendant; men of the time took pride in them.

units.zh: 保寧初，為政事舍人、知制誥，累遷翰林學士，加禮部侍郎。
units.en: At the beginning of Baoning he served as drafting academician for political affairs and edicts, rose through repeated promotions to Hanlin academician, and was given the additional title of vice minister of Rites.
units.literal: At the beginning of Baoning he served as drafting academician for political affairs and edicts, was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin academician, and was given the additional title of vice minister of Rites.

units.zh: 聖宗沖年嗣位，睿智皇后稱制，留心聽斷，嘗勸帝宜寬法律。
units.en: Shengzong succeeded as a child; the Wise Empress Dowager held regency, attended carefully to judgments, and urged him to lighten the laws.
units.literal: Shengzong succeeded the throne in his youth; the Wise Empress Dowager held regency, attended carefully to hearings and judgments, and once urged the emperor to lighten the laws.

units.zh: 始自約敕之時，意乃慕宋伯姬及陳孝婦，不幸一為盜賊所污，遂行淫失，知其非禮，然不能自還。
units.en: At first she means to emulate Lady Bo Ji of Song and the filial wife of Chen; once defiled by bandits, she falls into debauchery, knows it is wrong, yet cannot turn back.
units.literal: At first, in the time of self-restraint, her intent then admired Lady Bo Ji of Song and the filial wife of Chen; unluckily once defiled by robbers, she then practiced debauchery and loss, knowing it was not ritual, yet could not return herself.

units.zh: 乙未，以劉慎行為南院樞密使，南府宰相邢抱質知南院樞密使事。
units.en: On yiwei day Liu Shenxing was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner and Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi was assigned to manage Southern Privy Commissioner affairs.
units.literal: On yiwei day, made Liu Shenxing Southern Privy Commissioner, Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi to know Southern Privy Commissioner affairs.

units.zh: 癸丑，以知南院樞密使事邢抱質年老，詔乘小車入朝。
units.en: On guichou day, because Xing Baozhi, who managed Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, was advanced in years, an edict allowed him to attend court in a small cart.
units.literal: On guichou day, because Associate Southern Privy Commissioner Xing Baozhi was old in years, edict ordered riding small cart to attend court.

units.zh: 二十九年春正月乙亥朔，班師，所降諸城復叛。
units.en: In the twenty-ninth year, on the yihai new moon of the first spring month the army withdrew; the cities that had surrendered all rebelled again.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, on yihai new moon, army withdrew; the surrendered cities all rebelled again.

units.zh: 戊子，以殿前都點檢耶律義先為行軍都部署，忠順軍節度使夏行美副部署，東北面詳穩耶律朮者為監軍，伐蒲奴裏酋陶得裏。
units.en: On wuzi day, Yelü Yixian, commander of the Palace Front, was appointed supreme campaign commander; Xia Xingmei, military commissioner of the Zhongshun Army, was appointed his deputy; and Yelü Shuzhe, Northeastern xiangwen, was appointed army supervisor for the campaign against Taodeli, chieftain of Puniuli.
units.literal: On wuzi day, appointed Palace Front commander Yelü Yixian supreme campaign commander, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xia Xingmei deputy commander, and Northeastern xiangwen Yelü Shuzhe army supervisor, to attack Taodeli, chieftain of Puniuli.

units.zh: 及聞皇太子被害，不勝哀痛，以詩傷之，作《放懷詩》二十首。
units.en: When he heard that the crown prince had been murdered he was overcome with grief; he mourned him in verse and composed twenty poems entitled Poems of Letting Go the Heart.
units.literal: When he heard that the crown prince had been murdered he could not overcome his grief; he mourned him in verse and composed twenty poems entitled "Poems of Letting Go the Heart."

units.zh: 明年，流保州。
units.en: The following year he was exiled to Baozhou.
units.literal: The next year he was exiled to Baozhou.
